frontmatter.title: The Question of Questions
frontmatter.statement: How should the field decide which open problem to work on first?
frontmatter.progress: A published value-of-information estimate for each open problem, updated as problems are solved.
frontmatter.bounty: Unfunded. The Question Bounties program will attach prizes once it is funded.

subject.body:
## Why it matters

Research money is limited too. The first problems solved should be the ones whose answers would change the most decisions.

## Where to start

For each problem, estimate how much money would move if it were solved and how likely a solution is in the next five years. Publish the estimates and let the [Forecasting Platform](/tools/forecasting-platform/) test them.
